discoverySentence.text: All weapon output is stored and unleashed together every three seconds with 35% bonus power.

trigger.condition: global beat every 3 active-simulation seconds; no weapon damage or control between beats

pauseBehavior.rule: Fabrication and other full-simulation pauses freeze the beat and stored-output state.

acquisition.method: found in a relic cache through map exploration

unlock.effect: Permanently adds the relic to the random relic-cache selection pool; it neither equips nor guarantees that relic.

acquisition.cacheOpening: automatic on mech contact; freezes the complete gameplay simulation
acquisition.resolution: immediate install-or-sell; no relic inventory or deferred decision

rarityAndWeighting.selectionModel: three distinct relics drawn without replacement from the currently unlocked pool and assigned to the three caches during generation

stackingAndExclusivity.modifierOrder: Relic-specific multipliers apply after the additive percentage modifiers supplied by mech traits, utilities, and PowerUps unless the relic explicitly replaces targeting or cadence.
overridesOrReplaces: weapon output timing (all output gated to the global beat)

behaviorRegistration.hook: output capture and global beat release
behaviorRegistration.registrationModel: Relics are cross-cutting policies registered by stable relic ID. They modify well-defined hook points rather than scattering ID checks through every weapon.
behaviorRegistration.perWeaponCompatibilityManifest: produced from tests; states fully affected, partially affected with disclosed reason, or invalid. The initial design expects no invalid pairing.

rules.text: Weapons do not deal damage or apply control between global three-second beats.
Each weapon continues accumulating the attacks, movement triggers, or continuous output it would ordinarily have produced, up to two beats of stored output.
On each beat, every stored weapon releases its accumulated output in a synchronized burst from the mech's current position and facing, using the current valid target state.
Released damage and other scalable weapon output receive a 35% bonus. The beat does not erase ordinary targeting, branch behavior, capacity rules, or attack geometry.
The HUD, audio, and mech effect telegraph the next beat clearly enough for the player to approach, face, or retreat around it.
Fabrication and other full-simulation pauses freeze the beat and stored-output state.
